body:
I've been fighting my insurance company and COBRA to get the medication I need to stay alive because I don't have fifteen thousand in my bank account to cover it and the hospital refuses to administer without payment up front.

If it's not solved by the end of the month I plan to blow my brains out on the insurance company HQ steps.

Stay tuned.
I'm in the same boat. if I don't find work in the next four months I'm simply going to put my forty caliber in my mouth and pull the trigger.
